description: authorize() acceptance cases for native SDKs. Run each case against ONE fresh replay store, steps in order. `expect` is the native pipeline outcome (sorted failing checks); `ts` is the TypeScript authorize() outcome when recorded.

cases.name: envelope-predicate-within
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-predicate), a $50 payment: allowed.

cases.name: envelope-predicate-400-refused
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-predicate), a validly signed $400 payment: refused before the handler runs.

expect.reason: amount <= 100 not satisfied for payments.send on payments/acme

cases.name: envelope-predicate-signed-50-executes-400
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-predicate): a proof signed for $50 used to execute $400 is refused (binding, and the limit judges the executed $400).

cases.name: envelope-max-spend-within
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-max-spend), a $50 payment: allowed.

cases.name: envelope-max-spend-400-refused
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-max-spend), a validly signed $400 payment: refused before the handler runs.

cases.name: envelope-max-spend-signed-50-executes-400
cases.description: $100 limit (envelope-max-spend): a proof signed for $50 used to execute $400 is refused (binding, and the limit judges the executed $400).

cases.name: root-max-spend-within
cases.description: $100 limit (root-max-spend), a $50 payment: allowed.

cases.name: root-max-spend-400-refused
cases.description: $100 limit (root-max-spend), a validly signed $400 payment: refused before the handler runs.

cases.name: root-max-spend-signed-50-executes-400
cases.description: $100 limit (root-max-spend): a proof signed for $50 used to execute $400 is refused (binding, and the limit judges the executed $400).

cases.name: delegated-max-spend-within
cases.description: $100 limit (delegated-max-spend), a $50 payment: allowed.

cases.name: delegated-max-spend-400-refused
cases.description: $100 limit (delegated-max-spend), a validly signed $400 payment: refused before the handler runs.

cases.name: delegated-max-spend-signed-50-executes-400
cases.description: $100 limit (delegated-max-spend): a proof signed for $50 used to execute $400 is refused (binding, and the limit judges the executed $400).

cases.name: operation-other-verb
cases.description: A payments.send proof used for payments.refund (same params): refused.

cases.name: operation-other-resource
cases.description: A proof for payments/acme used on payments/mallory: refused.

cases.name: operation-other-params
cases.description: A proof for one payee used for another (same amount): refused.

cases.name: replay
cases.description: Counter 1 allowed, the same PCActn again refused, counter 2 allowed, counter 1 again refused (monotone per grant + holder).

expect.reason: replay: 1 is not greater than last seen 1

cases.name: denied-does-not-consume
cases.description: A denied action does not consume its counter: $500 refused at counter 1, then a $50 action at counter 1 is allowed.

cases.name: revoked
cases.description: A valid $50 payment under a revoked grant: refused.

cases.name: root-unknown-caveat
cases.description: An unknown root caveat type ("note") fails closed.

cases.name: delegated-unknown-caveat
cases.description: An unknown delegated caveat type fails closed.

cases.name: delegated-predicates-within
cases.description: A delegated predicates caveat (payments/acme only): a payment to acme is allowed.

cases.name: delegated-predicates-outside
cases.description: The same caveat: a payment to payments/other is refused (the envelope alone would allow it).

cases.name: delegated-tool-schema-within
cases.description: A delegated tool_schema caveat (amount <= 100, currency usd): $50 allowed.

cases.name: delegated-tool-schema-400
cases.description: The same caveat: $400 refused.

cases.name: delegated-tool-schema-extra-arg
cases.description: The same caveat: an argument the schema does not declare is refused.

cases.name: delegated-tool-schema-bound-tool
cases.description: The same caveat with a signed tool_binding equal to its signature digest: allowed.

cases.name: delegated-tool-schema-other-binding
cases.description: The same caveat with a signed tool_binding for another tool signature: refused.

cases.name: no-envelope
cases.description: A grant without a policy envelope: refused (default deny).

cases.name: envelope-predicate-verb
cases.description: Envelope predicates permit refunds only: a send is refused.

cases.name: attestation-bound
cases.description: A grant that pins the agent (agent_binding.operator) needs an attestation: refused without one.

cases.name: wrong-audience
cases.description: A proof for another resource server: refused as unauthenticated.
